run.name: GFL Environmental Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (GFL)
run.summary: GFL is a scaled waste operator whose leverage rose sharply with the SECURE acquisition. The credit view is cautious: unadjusted leverage is 5.18x while management's run-rate figure is 3.8x, so integration and the covenant definition decide the outcome. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 11,696.4 and cash 296.5 over trailing Adjusted EBITDA 2,257.1 (Q3PR page:14). Excludes leases of 705.0. Includes SECURE debt in full but only one month of SECURE EBITDA, so overstated against a pro forma basis; management Net Leverage with run-rate EBITDA 2,988.0 is 3.8x. Not the revolver covenant ratio

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The credit agreement, annual statements and take-private terms are not supplied, so covenant headroom and event risk cannot be sized.
CP-1 main limitation: The credit agreement and full-year 2025 statements are not in the pack, so covenant headroom and full-year cash interest cannot be tested.
